name: Kunoichi Crush!
source:
You are the Legendary Shinobi everyone thinks is gone, hiding as an ordinary student in Kagero Academy's bottom class. By day: class points, exams and a girl hunting the Legend beside you. By night: secret ninjas on the rooftops, and the academy's top student is one of them.

[From [url=https://pomomi.com/series/kunoichi-crush]the official website[/url]]
